presentation.label: Kit A/B
presentation.summary: Hold TRK and press NO to hear the temp-saved kit against your current edits, and again to get your edits back.
presentation.overview: Kit A/B, by ceredmeat, compares the sound you are tweaking with the one you last saved, without losing either. FUNC + YES temp-saves the pattern and its kit as usual: that is B. Your edits since are A. Hold TRK and press NO to hear B, with a small B in the top-right corner; press it again and your edits come back. The temp-saved copy is never overwritten, so FUNC + YES and FUNC + NO work as before. Only the kit switches: trigs and parameter locks stay as they are.
highlights: TRK + NO switches between your edited kit (A) and the temp-saved kit (B).
A small B shows in the top-right corner while you hear the saved kit.
FUNC + YES and FUNC + NO work as before; the temp-saved copy is never overwritten.
Only the kit switches; trigs and parameter locks stay as they are.
usage: Press FUNC + YES to temp-save the pattern and its kit.
Change a few sounds, for example FLTR FREQ on track 1.
Hold TRK and press NO: you hear the saved kit, and B shows in the top-right corner.
Hold TRK and press NO again: your edits come back.

access.location: Any page: hold TRK, press NO
steps: Use a build containing Kit A/B for the original Digitakt on OS 1.54.
Temp-save with FUNC + YES, then edit sounds.
Hold TRK and press NO to switch between your edits and the saved kit.

controls.name: TRK + NO
controls.doc: Switch between your edited kit (A) and the temp-saved kit (B). A small B shows in the top-right corner while you hear B.

controls.name: FUNC + YES
controls.doc: Stock temp-save: the kit saved here becomes B.

limitations: Needs core 4.1 or newer, so it does not build beside Digi EQ 1.0.2, which builds only on core 2.1.
Anything changed while hearing B is thrown away when you switch back to A.
Changing pattern while on B puts your edits back into the pattern you left (KIT A KEPT).
NO TEMP SAVE YET shows when there is no temp-saved copy: press FUNC + YES once first.

load.display: Runs on the UI side only, nothing in the audio render
load.conditions: From the source: its handlers subscribe to ev_key, ev_tick and ev_draw and call the stock kit reload; it has no render handler and patches no site. Not measured on a unit in Modwerk.

hardware.summary: The author tested Ctrl All, Kit A/B and Real Units 0.2 on a Digitakt MKI on OS 1.54, together with seven other FLEXMODS mods, elekloader's core and seq-events (FLEXMODS 1.0, 16 November 2026; the same files ship unchanged through FLEXMODS 1.5). This module pins that released file.
limitations: The author's report gives no duration: testedOn is the FLEXMODS 1.0 release date.
Tested with elekloader's core and other FLEXMODS mods in the build, not with Modwerk's library mods.
Not tested in Modwerk on a unit.

tests.summary: The author's released 0.2 file, pinned unchanged, linked locally on OS 1.54 with core 4.4 beside every Digitakt mod in the library: it builds beside all of them except Digi EQ 1.0.2 (core 2.1 only). Emulator captures show where it appears; nothing ran on a unit in Modwerk.
